data.value: The code is not valid. Please try again.

data.value: Sign in with a recovery code

data.value: Each recovery code can be used once.

data.name: EnableAuthenticator.Description
data.value: Protect your account with an authenticator app.

data.value: Two-factor authentication is required for your account. Set it up to continue.

data.name: EnableAuthenticator.Step1
data.value: Install an authenticator app on your phone (for example Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator).

data.name: EnableAuthenticator.Step2
data.value: Scan this QR code with the app.

data.name: EnableAuthenticator.Step3
data.value: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.

data.value: QR code for setting up the authenticator app

data.name: EnableAuthenticator.ManualKey
data.value: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually:

data.value: Set up two-factor authentication to continue.

data.name: RecoveryCodes.Description
data.value: Use one of these codes to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app.

data.name: RecoveryCodes.Warning
data.value: Store these codes in a safe place now. They are shown only once and each code works only once.

data.name: Manage.ProfileHint

data.name: Manage.TwoFactorHint

data.name: Manage.ResetAuthenticatorWarning
data.value: Resetting creates a new key: your current app stops working and you must set it up again before continuing.

data.name: Manage.TwoFactorDisabled

data.name: Users.Description
data.value: Staff accounts, their single role and the attributes the role requires.

data.name: Users.StaffHint
data.value: Search, filter and sort; toggle who is working today.

data.name: Users.SearchPlaceholder
data.value: Search name, user name or email…

data.name: Users.CreateHint
data.value: The user receives a temporary password and must change it at first sign-in.

data.name: Users.EditHint
data.value: Account details, role and the attributes the role requires.

data.name: Users.AccessChangeWarning
data.value: Changing the role or the branch signs the user out of their open sessions within a minute.

data.name: Users.UserNameHint
data.value: 3–64 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores, e.g. tamta.tatishvili.

data.name: Users.CapacityHint
data.value: Maximum number of open files at once (0–100).

data.name: Users.ChooseRoleFirst
data.value: Choose a role to see whether it requires a branch.

data.name: Users.RoleHasNoAttributes
data.value: This role is not tied to a branch.

data.name: Users.RequireMfaHint
data.value: The user must set up an authenticator app at first sign-in, even if the role does not require it.

data.name: Users.Deactivated
data.value: The user has been deactivated and signed out.

data.name: Users.SignedOut
data.value: The user's sessions end within a minute.

data.name: Users.MfaRequired
data.value: Two-factor authentication is now required for this user.

data.name: Users.MfaNotRequired
data.value: Two-factor authentication is no longer required for this user (unless the role requires it).

data.name: Users.RecentActivityHint
data.value: The last 10 audit records where this user acted or was changed.

data.name: Users.Confirm.Deactivate.Description
data.value: The user can no longer sign in, open sessions end within a minute and they are marked unavailable. The account is kept and can be activated again.

data.name: Users.Confirm.ForceSignOut.Description
data.value: All open sessions end within a minute. The user can sign in again.

data.name: Users.Confirm.ResetPassword.Description
data.value: A new temporary password replaces the current one and open sessions end. The new password is shown once; give it to the user securely.

data.name: Users.TempPassword.ShownOnce
data.value: This temporary password is shown only once. Give it to the user securely; they must change it at first sign-in.

data.name: Roles.Description
data.value: Each user has exactly one role. A role's permissions decide what its users can see and do.

data.name: Roles.RolesHint
data.value: Data scope, dashboard and field rules are fixed per role; permissions and the two-factor requirement are editable.

data.name: Roles.MatrixHint
data.value: Who holds which permission. Open a role to change its permissions.

data.name: Roles.MfaHint
data.value: When required, every user of this role must set up an authenticator app at their next sign-in.

data.name: Roles.MfaRequired
data.value: Two-factor authentication is now required for this role.

data.name: Roles.MfaNotRequired
data.value: Two-factor authentication is no longer required for this role.

data.name: Roles.SodReadOnly
data.value: Segregation of duties: a read-only role can hold only read permissions, never one that changes data.

data.name: Roles.SodBusiness
data.value: Segregation of duties: a business role cannot hold administration permissions.

data.name: Roles.SodAdministrative
data.value: Segregation of duties: the administrator role holds only administration permissions and must keep "Manage users" and "Manage roles".

data.name: Roles.SaveHint
data.value: Changes apply to every user of this role on their next page load, without signing out.

data.name: Roles.Saved
data.value: The role's permissions have been saved.

data.name: RoleKind.Business.Description
data.value: Works with loan data; cannot hold administration permissions.

data.name: RoleKind.ReadOnly.Description
data.value: Reads loan data and the audit log; cannot hold any permission that changes data.

data.name: RoleKind.Administrative.Description
data.value: Administers the system; holds only administration permissions and sees no loan data.

data.name: DataScope.Branch.Description
data.value: All records of the user's branch.

data.name: Branches.Description
data.value: Branches staff can be assigned to. A branch in use is deactivated, never deleted.

data.name: Branches.CreateHint
data.value: The code cannot be changed later.

data.name: Branches.EditHint
data.value: Name and city can be changed; the code is permanent.

data.name: Branches.CodeHint
data.value: 2–10 letters, digits or hyphens, e.g. VAK. Stored in upper case and never changed.

data.name: Branches.Deactivate.Description
data.value: It can no longer be chosen for users. The {0} user(s) assigned to it keep it until you change them. You can activate it again at any time.

data.name: Branches.Delete.Description
data.value: No user is assigned to it, so it can be deleted. The deletion is audited and cannot be undone.

data.name: Audit.Description
data.value: Every sign-in, security event and administrative change. Records cannot be changed or deleted.

data.name: Audit.RecordsHint
data.value: Newest first. Open a record to see what changed.

data.name: Audit.ActorFilter
data.value: Only records where this user acted

data.name: Audit.ChangesHint
data.value: Before and after, as stored. Passwords, security stamps and authenticator keys are never recorded.

data.name: Audit.NoChanges
data.value: This event records no data change.

data.name: Inbox.Underwriting.Description
data.value: Applications waiting for an underwriting decision within your authority. Your own applications and applications you already decided are never listed.

data.name: Inbox.Committee.Description
data.value: Applications above the Senior Underwriter threshold waiting for your vote. Two matching votes decide.

data.name: Inbox.Compliance.Description
data.value: Applications held for a sanctions or PEP match. Clear them to continue or reject them with a reason.

data.name: Clients.Description
data.value: Registered clients with their identity documents, incomes and obligations.

data.name: Clients.RegisterHint
data.value: Enter the client's data from the identity document. The personal number has 11 digits and is unique.

data.name: Applications.Description
data.value: Applications you may see, newest first. Filters, sorting and paging run on the server.

data.name: Applications.SearchPlaceholder
data.value: Borrower, personal number, APP- number or contract number

data.name: Applications.NewHint
data.value: The borrower must be registered as a client first. Amount, term and rate must fit the product.

data.name: Applications.BorrowerHint
data.value: 11 digits; the client is found by personal number.

data.name: Applications.BorrowerNotFound
data.value: No client with this personal number. Register the client first.

data.name: Applications.Created
data.value: The draft was created. Add the documents and submit it.

data.name: Applications.Submitted
data.value: The application was submitted. The pre-check runs in the background.

data.name: Applications.SentToScoring
data.value: The application was sent to scoring.

data.name: Applications.OverrideNeeded
data.value: A scoring rule failed: only a user with the override permission can approve.

data.name: Applications.ContractSigned
data.value: The contract was signed and numbered.

data.name: Applications.Disbursed
data.value: The loan was disbursed. The schedule is booked in the background.

data.name: Applications.DisbursementPending
data.value: Core banking has not confirmed the payout yet; it is confirmed in the background with the same request, so it is never paid twice.

data.name: Applications.BookingLoan
data.value: The payout is confirmed; the loan and its schedule are being booked.

data.name: Applications.CheckHint
data.value: Core banking has not confirmed the payout yet. Asking again uses the same request, so nothing is paid twice.

data.name: Applications.CollateralHint
data.value: Valuation and registration are entered by hand; the valuation may be at most 6 months old.

data.name: Applications.DisburseHint
data.value: The payout goes to the borrower's account through core banking; a second click never pays twice.

data.name: Applications.PartiesHint
data.value: Co-borrowers and guarantors go through the same KYC, screening and scoring.

data.name: Applications.RetryHint
data.value: Core banking rejected the payout and no money moved. A retry uses the same request.

data.name: Applications.SignHint
data.value: The client signed the contract: the next contract number is assigned.

data.name: Applications.UploadHint
data.value: PDF, PNG or JPEG, at most 10 MB.

data.name: Applications.VoteTally
data.value: Votes to approve: {0}, to reject: {1}; {2} matching votes decide.

data.name: Loans.Description
data.value: Disbursed loans you may see, newest first.

data.name: Loans.SearchPlaceholder
data.value: Contract number, borrower or personal number

data.name: Wizard.ReviewHint
data.value: Check the data below and submit. The pre-check (KYC, sanctions, credit bureau) then runs automatically.

data.name: Rule.BUREAU_DPD30_12M
data.value: No payment 30+ days late in the last 12 months

data.name: Rule.PTI
data.value: Payment-to-income within the income band's limit

data.name: Rule.VALUATION_AGE
data.value: Collateral valuation at most 6 months old

data.name: Rule.FX_INCOME_CURRENCY
data.value: Foreign-currency loan needs income in that currency

data.name: Rule.PRODUCT_LIMITS
data.value: Amount, term and rate within the product

data.name: Products.Description
data.value: Loan products and their versioned terms. Saving terms publishes a new version; submitted applications keep the version they were submitted with.

data.name: Products.CreateHint
data.value: The code cannot be changed later. The terms become version 1.

data.name: Products.VersionPublished
data.value: A new version was published; it applies to applications submitted from now on.

data.name: Products.NextVersionHint
data.value: Change the terms and publish them as the next version. Nothing is published when nothing changed.

data.name: ScoringRules.Description
data.value: The rules of each rule-set version, their parameters and whether a failure can be overridden. The rule logic is code; a version is immutable and every scoring run records the version it used.

data.name: ScoringRules.NextVersionHint
data.value: Edit the rules and publish them as the next version; new scoring runs use it.

data.name: Thresholds.Description
data.value: Who decides which amount (GEL): up to the first limit an Underwriter, up to the second a Senior Underwriter, above it the Credit Committee.

data.name: Thresholds.Hint
data.value: The tier is fixed when an application is scored; files already routed keep their tier.

data.name: FxRates.Description
data.value: GEL per unit of USD and EUR from an effective date. Submission and scoring use the latest rate on or before their date.

data.name: FxRates.ImportHint
data.value: One rate per line: Currency,EffectiveDate,GelPerUnit (e.g. USD,2026-10-13,2.7150). Any wrong line rejects the whole file.

data.name: Holidays.Description
data.value: Public holidays do not count as working days (escalation after two working days in Underwriting).

data.name: Reports.Description
data.value: {0} – {1}, within your data scope. Amounts in GEL at the rate fixed when each application was scored.
